2608.24977.title: Retrieved But Not Reliable: A Survey on Attacks, and Defenses in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
2608.24977.paper_summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances large language models by grounding outputs in external knowledge, improving factuality and reducing hallucinations. At the same time, the retrieval-augmented pipeline introduces new robustness and security risks, including corpus poisoning, backdoor attacks, privacy leakage, and fairness violations. Despite rapid progress in this area, existing surveys remain limited in their treatment of attacker objectives, threat models, and stage-specific defenses across the full RAG pipeline. This survey presents a unified and pipeline-aware overview of RAG robustness. We formalize threat models over the corpus, retriever, and generator, and organize attacks into three main objectives: accuracy, privacy, and fairness. We further review defenses from a pipeline-aware perspective, covering the retrieval, rerank, generation, and traceback stages. In addition, we summarize robustness benchmarks and explainability methods for more deeply evaluating and explaining RAG robustness.
2608.24977.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）通過將輸出基於外部知識來增強大型語言模型，從而提高事實性並減少幻覺。同時，檢索增強管道引入了新的穩健性和安全風險，包括語料庫中毒、後門攻擊、隱私洩漏和公平性違規。儘管在這一領域取得了快速進展，但現有的調查在處理攻擊者目標、威脅模型和整個 RAG 管道的階段特定防禦方面仍然有限。本調查提供了一個統一且關注管道的 RAG 穩健性概述。我們對語料庫、檢索器和生成器的威脅模型進行了形式化，並將攻擊組織為三個主要目標：準確性、隱私和公平性。我們還從管道意識的角度回顧了防禦，涵蓋了檢索、重新排序、生成和回溯階段。此外，我們總結了穩健性基準和可解釋性方法，以更深入地評估和解釋 RAG 的穩健性。
